jobs.description_text: 关于我们 安贤投资（AXQ Capital） 是一家全球量化投资机构。我们立足不同地域、资产类别和交易周期，持续构建多元化的投资优势。我们的策略植根于严谨的量化研究与深入的市场理解，并通过对数据、技术和人工智能的长期投入不断强化。我们汇聚来自全球顶尖高校及领先量化机构的优秀人才，倡导以好奇心、严谨精神和主人翁意识为基础的合作文化。在这里，最好的想法能够脱颖而出，每个人也能与公司共同成长。 岗位使命 作为 AI 基础设施工程师（AI Infrastructure Engineer） 你将参与建设 AXQ 面向量化研究与机器学习的计算和平台基础设施，与 Infrastructure 团队及研究、工程团队紧密合作，提升特征计算、模型训练、实验迭代与推理任务的效率和可靠性。我们面向 PB 级数据处理与数十 TB 级训练数据的研究场景，持续优化 GPU/CPU 计算资源、分布式计算、存储与数据访问、机器学习平台及开发者工具。你将独立负责相关基础设施模块的设计、开发与交付，帮助研究人员更高效地使用计算资源，让研究工作流具备可扩展、可复现、易使用和成本高效的特性。 岗位职责 计算集群与任务调度： 参与建设和优化 GPU/CPU 集群、资源管理与任务调度系统，支持模型训练、特征计算及量化研究，提高资源利用率与多用户环境下的运行效率。 分布式训练与计算： 支持多 GPU、多节点训练及分布式计算任务，解决数据加载、节点通信、任务并行和故障恢复中的工程问题。 数据访问与性能优化： 与数据及研究团队协作，优化大规模数据处理、训练数据读取、缓存和存储访问，定位并改善计算、网络与 I/O 瓶颈。 机器学习平台与研究工具： 建设开发环境、任务提交、实验管理、依赖与镜像管理等平台能力，提升研究过程的可复现性和实验迭代效率。 训练与推理基础设施： 支持模型训练、批量及在线推理任务的部署和运行，完善环境交付、版本管理、监控及故障恢复流程。 自动化与稳定性建设： 通过代码和自动化管理基础设施，完善监控告警、权限隔离、资源配额与容量管理，持续提升系统的可靠性和可维护性。 需求落地与使用体验： 深入理解研究员和工程师的工作流，将共性需求转化为可复用的平台能力，推动工具落地并持续改进使用体验。 岗位要求 具备基础设施、平台工程、分布式系统、高性能计算或机器学习基础设施相关技术基础，能够完成模块设计、开发、部署与问题排查。 扎实的 Linux、网络、存储和操作系统基础，能够分析资源使用情况，定位性能与稳定性问题。 熟练掌握 Python、Go、C++、Rust、Java 等至少一门编程语言，具备良好的编码习惯和工程意识。 理解容器、任务调度与资源管理，熟悉 Kubernetes、Slurm、Ray 或同类系统中的至少一种。 理解 GPU 计算、分布式训练或大规模数据计算中的至少一个方向，了解相关任务对数据 I/O、网络通信和资源调度的要求。 了解 CI/CD、Infrastructure as Code、监控告警及自动化运维，重视系统的可观测性、可复现性与故障恢复能力。 具备良好的学习、沟通与协作能力，能够理解研究需求，分析技术取舍并推动方案落地。 加分项 有量化投资、对冲基金、机器学习平台或大规模研究计算平台经验。 有 GPU 集群建设、分布式训练性能调优经验，熟悉 PyTorch Distributed、NCCL、CUDA、RDMA 等相关技术。 有大规模特征工程、数据管道、分布式存储或 PB 级数据处理经验。 有模型服务、大模型微调或推理基础设施建设经验。 有公有云、混合云资源管理与

jobs.title: Lead AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description_text: About the Team Our team is at the core of Avride's self-driving stack. We build the base infrastructure layer that powers all autopilot code. It includes a C++ framework for implementing autonomy components, execution graph building and optimization systems, as well as runtimes that execute those graphs, both onboard and in simulation. The vast part of the execution graph is implemented as a chain of neural network operations. The onboard mode relies on stable latencies of the inference of those networks, while in simulation we also optimize throughput at scale. About the role We’re looking for a software engineer with a leadership mindset and deep ML infrastructure experience. You will decide and influence the ML infrastructure layer across the company. The biggest challenge we’re facing at the moment is the effectiveness of GPU inference - both for onboard applications with near real-time guarantees and for offboard cases that target high throughput and deterministic execution. It is the first priority within this role. What you'll do At first, you will take on the GPU inference framework, focusing on performance Later, the role assumes responsibility and ownership for broader ML infrastructure scattered across ML pipelines Close collaboration with the applied ML team responsible for defining the neural model's architecture What you'll need Experience with PyTorch Understanding of how GPUs work Experience in diagnosing and resolving performance issues Strong record of build

jobs.title: Lead Test Engineer AV Safety Assurance
jobs.department: Autonomous Vehicles / Motion planning / Offline testing
jobs.description_text: About the team Avride builds autonomous driving technology for vehicles and delivery robots, and tests it on public roads in Austin. Before anything reaches those roads it goes through our QA team: checks on every pull request, a daily validation of main, and release-candidate qualification over a large set of recorded scenes. Every one of those gates produces a verdict, and the safety part of that verdict is the one people act on. About the role You will own how safety is tested, judged and reported across our QA team. Our Head of Safety owns the company's safety framework and the safety case built on top of it. You own the layer beneath: the gates, the criteria and the reports that turn day-to-day testing into evidence that argument can rest on. The hard part of this is not the collisions. Those are obvious, and nobody argues about them. It is everything short of a collision the near miss, the late brake, the hesitation at an intersection that looked wrong to one engineer and fine to another where the judgement has to be made and then made the same way again next week, by someone else, on a different run. Turning that into criteria a whole team applies consistently is the craft of this role. You will lead through process and through people who do not report to you. What you’ll do Own the safety gates. jobs.title: Antenna Associate (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: Antenna Associate (Summer 2027) Internships at Astranis typically last for twelve weeks, and are hourly roles designed for students who are currently enrolled at a four-year university. As an Antenna Intern, you will work closely with mechanical, thermal, and payload system engineers to design, build and test antenna systems for ongoing and next-generation satellite payloads. Role Leverage cutting-edge design tools to realize high-performance communications antenna systems with on-orbit flexibility to meet evolving customer demand. Work with vendors to design and procure antenna and RF components and validate their performance through anechoic chamber testing. Co-design antenna components and systems in conjunction with other technical disciplines, including Mechanical/Structural/Thermal/Payload Systems. Requirements Fundamental understanding of electromagnetics, including antenna fundamentals, impedance matching, transmission lines, and circuit matching. Experience measuring components using vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, and signal sources. Demonstrated ability to solve engineering challenges in innovative and creative ways. Capable of using industry-standard design tools such as CST, HFSS, or TICRA and scripting to solve engineering problems using Matlab or Python. jobs.description_text: Automation & Controls Engineering Associate (Summer 2027) As an Automation & Controls Engineering Associate, you’ll help build the automated test infrastructure used to shake, heat, cool, evacuate, and otherwise stress satellite hardware during environmental testing. From electrical control systems and safety interlocks to test automation software and telemetry pipelines, your work will help enable safe, reliable, and repeatable spacecraft testing. You’ll work at the intersection of hardware and software, collaborating with experienced engineers and technicians from early design and prototyping through commissioning, validation, and operational support. jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.description_text: Business Development Associate As a Business Development Associate, you will play a key role in driving Astranis’ global growth strategy. You will help identify, engage, and develop relationships with prospective customers across enterprise, government, and telecommunications markets worldwide. Sitting at the intersection of sales, marketing, finance, and solutions engineering, you’ll support high-priority commercial pursuits and build the top of Astranis’ future pipeline. This is a high-impact role with visibility across the commercial organization, ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and is motivated to make an impact. Associate programs at Astranis typically last for a minimum of twelve weeks. Support inbound commercial inquiries by conducting initial research, qualifying opportunities, and coordinating next steps with the appropriate internal teams. jobs.title: Camera Operator Intern (Fall 2026)
jobs.description_text: Camera Operator Intern (Fall 2026) Astranis is looking for a Camera Operator Intern to help capture the people, technology, and work behind our missions. You'll film interviews, manufacturing processes, and behind-the-scenes moments that show what it takes to build satellites and bring them to space. This is a hands-on production role working closely with our Creative team. You'll help translate creative concepts into compelling footage, with a focus on camera operation, lighting, and audio. You'll gain exposure to satellite manufacturing and a fast-paced startup environment building technology that's launching into space. Role Work with our Creative team to bring scripts, shot lists, and visual concepts to life. Operate cameras for interviews, manufacturing videos, behind-the-scenes content, and company events. Capture compelling B-roll of our satellites, manufacturing processes, and the people behind our missions. Must have experience setting up and adjusting lighting for interviews, product shots, and on-location filming. Set up and adjust lighting for interviews and filming across our factory and office spaces. Set up microphones and monitor audio to capture clear, usable sound. Prepare and maintain cameras, lenses, lighting, audio, and support equipment. Organize and back up footage, providing clear handoffs to editors. jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Backend Software Engineer (Java), mid to senior level, to join the Metadata Platform DB team. This team owns Postgres end-to-end - from infrastructure and provisioning to the software layer that sits on top of it - and is looking for someone to help maintain and grow that ecosystem. The Tech Stack Cloud Infrastructure: Cloud-native platform, expanding beyond current AWS and Azure dependencies toward provider-agnostic deployment. Core Technologies: Java, Postgres. Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, a Go-based operator. Systems components: Rust (database proxy). Containerization: Kubernetes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Engine Orchestration
jobs.description_text: The Team: The Engine Orchestration team builds and operates the distributed services that run, scale and balance the analytical query engines. We are the layer that turns a customer's model into something they and their AI agents can query interactively using our Process Query Language across enterprise-sized datasets. The team actively evolves our new premium query engine, collaborating with multiple other teams across time zones. New features, improved operationability, robust security, and allowing for scalable customer workloads are ours to design and ship. Our defining program right now is a multi-year migration of the query engine that has powered Celonis for years onto our new premium query engine. It is one of the largest and highest-leverage engineering efforts in the company. The Role: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to lead both the engineering that evolves the new premium query engine and the execution of milestones within the migration program that moves customer workloads onto it. This is not a lift and shift. The two query engines evolved with different focus areas and the new premium query engine serves different forward looking use cases, so the job is keeping customer workloads running seamlessly throughout. You will analyze how the engines differ on real customer workloads, develop tooling, classify the root causes, and turn them into concrete follow up actions across teams. jobs.title: Senior Data Science Manager, Developer Platform
jobs.description_text: Discord is where the world's gamers hang out, and increasingly, it's the platform game developers build on. We're seeking a Senior Data Science Manager to lead Data Science for our Developer Platform: the SDKs, identity systems, and developer tools that connect games and their players to Discord. What makes this role distinctive is the two-sided value equation at the heart of the platform. For game developers, we build tools that help studios grow player engagement and revenue, including data products that give them deeper insight into their players and communities. For players, we use signals from those same tools to make it easier to play and hang out with friends, deepen engagement across Discord, and deliver more relevant ads. Your team's job is to make both sides of that exchange demonstrably valuable.
